t: DEWALT Bevel Edge 4 piece chisel set contains a robust collection of woodworking hand tools designed for precise timber work and mortise joint creation. Features hardened and tempered chrome carbon steel blades to provide excellent edge retention and durability. Each blade is lacquered for corrosion protection and extended tool life. An ergonomically designed bi-material handle ensures comfortable use and enhanced control during prolonged tasks, complemented by a steel strike cap for reliable striking performance. Includes 6, 12, 18 and 25mm chisels, ideal for joiners, carpenters and general builders.
